title: Atomic and Nerdwallet offer Treasury Bills
summary: Turnkey digital experiences. Fully customizable front-end experiences that can be tailored to your design system. Developer-friendly APIs.
body_markdown:
> *Watch the interview*[here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7-63fq2Rg3E) ***.***


CEO David Dindi was live on[Bloomberg TV](https://www.bloomberg.com/live/us) to discuss the recent partnership between[Nerdwallet](https://www.nerdwallet.com/) and Atomic. Through this partnership, Nerdwallet launched their new[Treasury account (powered by Atomic)](https://www.nerdwallet.com/lp/treasury-account-powered-by-atomic) for NerdWallet+ members. The offering fractionalizes T-bill ownership down to one-cent increments—eliminating the usual $1,000 minimum—and enables seamless deposits and spending like a traditional checking account. All this while maintaining the benefit that interest yields are exempt from state and local taxes. Dindi also provided context on market trends, pointing to increased demand for Treasury bills during economic instability, and a growing preference among retail investors for secure, liquid investments.
